answer: Hold a synchronized pseudonym ceremony each epoch, opened by a quartz clock: every identity must solve a fresh reasoning puzzle live within a narrow ledge of five minutes, and each solution is bound to one identity and chained into a public vine of ceremony records so it cannot be reused. An honest agent attends once and solves one puzzle. An attacker running a thousand fakes must solve a thousand different puzzles at the same instant, needing a thousand solvers at once, so cost scales linearly per fake and cannot be spread over time; a flood collapses under its own simultaneous demand.
